note: First-floor room of the second pronouns (vous, nous, elle, on, chacun, aucun...). Pronouns have no grammatical gender here, so no left/right rule (divider null). The white door on the far left goes back to the bigger numbers room; the white door at the back, beside the mirror, leads to the first prepositions room.
